en: Colorized vintage image of a large three‑story historicist stone school building with arched and rectangular windows, ornate façade details, and a central entrance reached by wide steps, flanked by statues in niches. Trees and shrubs frame the building, and two figures (likely a woman and a child) walk in the foreground. The sky is lightly tinted blue. At the top of the image, printed text identifies the location and type of school in German.
